description.zh:
经典网络地址保留的天数，取值**1-120**，单位：天。默认值：**7**。
>若传入参数**RetainClassic**=**True**，则该参数必传。
description.en:
The number of days for which you want to retain the classic network endpoint. Valid values: **1 to 120**. Default value: **7**.

> If you set the **RetainClassic** parameter to **True**, you must also specify this parameter.
The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

description.zh: 目标网络类型，取值固定为**VPC**：专有网络。
description.en: The network type after the modification. Set the value to **VPC**.

description.zh: 设置实例的内网IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过**VPCId**和**VSwitchId**自动分配。
description.en: The internal IP address of the instance. The internal IP address must be within the CIDR block supported by the specified vSwitch. The system automatically assigns a private IP address to an instance based on the values of **VPCId** and **VSwitchId**.

description.zh:
读写分离的经典网络地址保留的天数，取值**1-120**，单位：天。默认值：**7**。
>当实例存在经典网络类型的读写分离地址，且**RetainClassic**=**True**，本参数有效。
description.en:
The number of days for which you want to retain the read/write splitting endpoint of the classic network type. Valid values: **1 to 120**. Default value: **7**.

>  This parameter takes effect only when a read/write splitting endpoint of the classic network type exists and the **RetainClassic** parameter is set to **True**.

description.zh:
设置实例的内网读写分离地址的IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过**VPCId**和**VSwitchId**自动分配。

>当前实例存在经典网络类型的读写分离地址时，该值有效。
description.en:
The internal IP address that corresponds to the read/write splitting endpoint of the instance. The internal IP address must be within the CIDR block supported by the specified vSwitch. The system automatically assigns a private IP address to an instance based on the values of **VPCId** and **VSwitchId**.

>  This parameter is valid when a read/write splitting endpoint of the classic network type exists.

description.zh:
是否保留经典网络地址，取值：
* **True**：保留
* **False**（默认）：不保留
description.en:
Specifies whether to retain the classic network endpoint. Valid values:

*   **True**: retains the classic network endpoint.
*   **False** (default): does not retain the classic network endpoint.

description.zh: 交换机ID，若传入**VPCId**，则该参数必传。
description.en: The ID of the vSwitch. This parameter is required if the **VPCId** parameter is specified.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-network-type --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --retain-classic True --classic-expired-days 7 --instance-network-type VPC --read-write-splitting-classic-expired-days 7 --vpc-id vpc-uf6f7l4fg900000 --vswitch-id vsw-uf6adz52c2p0000 --private-ip-address 172.10.XX.XX --read-write-splitting-private-ip-address 192.168.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds ModifyDBInstanceNetworkType --region cn-hangzhou --RetainClassic True --PrivateIpAddress '172.10.XX.XX' --ClassicExpiredDays 7 --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --VPCId 'vpc-uf6f7l4fg900000' --ReadWriteSplittingPrivateIpAddress '192.168.XX.XX' --VSwitchId 'vsw-uf6adz52c2p0000' --ReadWriteSplittingClassicExpiredDays 7 --InstanceNetworkType VPC
